name: Kissimmee Concrete Cost Index
scope: Installed planning ranges for residential concrete, paver and coating work in Kissimmee, Osceola County and the Polk County ridge, Florida. Not quotes.

items.item: Concrete driveway, broom finish, 4 in, 3,000 psi, fiber + rebar at edges
items.notes: New pour on prepared base; demolition of an old slab adds $2.00–$4.00

items.item: Concrete driveway, 6 in, 4,000 psi with #4 rebar grid (RV/boat loads)
items.notes: Thicker slab, more steel, same forming and finishing labor

items.item: Concrete patio, 4 in, broom or smooth
items.notes: Small pours cost more per foot; under 200 sq ft expect the top of the range

items.item: Stamped concrete, integral color + release + sealer
items.notes: Pattern complexity and two-color work push toward the top

items.item: Concrete pad (shed, AC, generator, hot tub), 4 in
items.notes: Minimum-charge jobs; a 10x12 pad typically lands at $1,200–$1,900

items.item: Demolition and haul-off of existing concrete
items.notes: Thicker slabs and limited access cost more

items.item: Polymer overlay / resurfacing over sound concrete
items.notes: Only over slabs with a stable base

items.item: Paver driveway, concrete pavers (60–80 mm), 6 in limerock base
items.notes: Borders, bands and cuts add; removal of old concrete adds $2.00–$4.00

items.item: Paver driveway, premium line (Belgard Luxury, large format)
Paver patio, concrete pavers, 4–5 in base
Paver pool deck over existing deck (thin pavers, coping)
items.notes: Coping and drain work priced separately

items.item: Travertine pool deck, tumbled, sand-set or thin-set
items.notes: Marble and large-format porcelain run higher
Narrow runs cost more per foot
Stripping an old failed sealer adds $0.75–$1.50

items.item: Paver lift-and-relay of a sunken area
items.notes: Minimum charge applies to small areas

items.item: Garage floor coating, flake system with polyaspartic top coat

items.notes: Supplier public price lists, Sept 2026; short-load and fuel surcharges extra
